sources.title: GitHub - openai/privacy-filter: OpenAI Privacy Filter
sources.snippet: After this, you will have a python script opf that can be run directly or via python -m opf. The script can be used in 3 separate ways, as described below. Run one-shot redaction: By default, opf looks for a model at the directory pointed to by the OPF_CHECKPOINT variable, or ~/.opf/privacy_filter. If a model is not found in the ~/.opf/privacy_filter location, it will be downloaded.
